headline: Marcopolo Q3 Net Profit Falls 43% to R$ 186.5 Million
summary: Brazilian bus manufacturer Marcopolo reported a 43% drop in third-quarter net profit to R$ 186.5 million, hit by declining bus sales volumes abroad and domestically.
why: Marcopolo is a major global bus body manufacturer, making its financial results an indicator of heavy vehicle demand and manufacturing sector health.

impacts.name: Marcopolo S.A.
impacts.why: Net profit fell 43% in the third quarter.
